## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added a command-line tool to inspect recorded pipeline inputs and check consistency for selected worlds, with verified proofs and detailed reports.
  * Added commands to check and run the recorded-input consistency tool.
  * Reasoning results now include asserted and inferred facts, along with the selected witness.
* **Improvements**
  * Error reports now retain more information about the type and source of failures.
* **Refactor**
  * Updated graph selection across pipeline and related tools.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
The workspace updates PurRDF dependencies and graph projection calls. The pipeline adds a recorded-product consistency example. The logic crate changes timing and semantic identity handling, while diagnostic failure-class metadata and reason-wasm witness assets are updated.

**Changes: PurRDF graph projection migration**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Update graph projection callers** <br> `Cargo.toml`, `fuzz/Cargo.toml`, `crates/bundle-view/src/diagnostics_reader.rs`, `crates/conformance/{Cargo.toml,src/compare.rs}`, `crates/mcp/src/{lib.rs,tests.rs}`, `crates/pipeline/src/{cache.rs,medium/*,stages/*}`, `crates/pipeline/tests/*`, `crates/validate/tests/conformance_support/mod.rs`, `slices/core/pipeline/module.ttl`|PurRDF dependencies now point to a new revision. Graph-selection callers and related tests use `project_graph` with RDF IRI terms. The LPG description refers to native graph projection.|

**Recorded-product consistency consumer**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Expose recorded-input contracts** <br> `crates/pipeline/src/{error.rs,scheduler.rs,stages/carrier.rs}`, `slices/core/pipeline/{module.ttl,i18n/*}`|The pipeline registers a `RecordedInput` diagnostic and makes `ActionIdentity` and `assemble_object_level_edb` public. The ontology and translations describe recorded-consumer failures and boundaries.|
|**Add recorded consistency command** <br> `Makefile`, `crates/pipeline/Cargo.toml`, `crates/pipeline/examples/recorded-class-consistency.rs`|The example validates receipts, hydrates products through the read-only native cache, assembles an EDB, and evaluates consistency with proof verification. Make targets type-check and run the example.|

**Reasoning runtime and witness updates**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Add cross-target timing** <br> `crates/logic/Cargo.toml`, `crates/logic/src/{lib.rs,timing.rs,physical/*,program_analysis.rs,reason/program.rs}`|The logic crate adds a timing abstraction. Browser builds use `performance.now()`; other targets use `std::time::Instant`. Existing timing measurements use this abstraction.|
|**Separate semantic and execution identities** <br> `crates/logic/src/reason/{mod.rs,mod.tests.rs}`|The PurRDF substrate identity now uses canonical rule hashes and excludes execution limits. Tests check the semantic identity and distinct execution-profile hashes.|
|**Refresh reason-wasm witness outputs** <br> `Makefile`, `crates/reason-wasm/{Cargo.toml,examples/*,src/lib.rs,tests/*}`|The reason-wasm refresh example writes closure output and a conjecture attestation. The closure fixture is shared with its test, and the witness data and API documentation are updated. The Makefile builds six engine packages, applies hyphen-to-underscore artifact naming, and uses a shared recipe for MCP packages.|

**Failure-class metadata**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|:---|:---|
|**Classify compiler source refusals** <br> `crates/logic-compile/src/{error.rs,frontend/tests.rs,xcl/tests.rs}`, `slices/grounding/logic/{module.ttl,i18n/*,tests/competency.ttl}`|Compiler source-read and source-parse diagnostics use `CompilerSourceRefusal`. The ontology, translations, and competency data describe and check the refusal class and boundary.|
|**Preserve failure classes in evidence and reports** <br> `crates/logic/src/{external_evidence.rs,external_evidence.tests.rs}`, `crates/gmeow-cli/src/commands/reasoning_report.rs`|Artifact diagnostics and reasoning report evidence retain failure-class metadata. Tests check its propagation and JSON representation.|

### Sequence Diagram(s)

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
  participant CLI as recorded-class-consistency
  participant Receipts as Receipt files
  participant Cache as Read-only native cache
  participant Assembly as assemble_object_level_edb
  participant Reasoner as OWL 2 Direct reasoning
  CLI->>Receipts: Read and validate stage receipts
  CLI->>Cache: Hydrate and verify recorded products
  CLI->>Assembly: Assemble products into an EDB
  CLI->>Reasoner: Evaluate consistency
  Reasoner-->>CLI: Return proof for verification
```
